logp.method_description: The partition coefficient of 99mTc-VFC was determined in a biphasic system according to Tuher and al. [22]. In a two-phase system consisting of 2 ml of n-octanol and 2 ml of 50 mM Tris.HCl buffer pH 7.4, 100 μl of 99mTc-VFC reconstituted in ethanol were added. The mixture was stirred for 1 min and then centrifuged (5000 rpm/5 min). The n-octanol phase (supernatant) was transferred to another tube containing 2 ml of buffer and centrifuged again. The whole procedure was repeated three times. From each phase, 100 μl was taken. The radioactivity of each phase is measured using a gamma well counter.
